newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies seven muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies seven muni issues for insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co said Wednesday it qualified for bond insurance the following seven municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--South Suburb Park and Recreation, Colo., $4.7 million of general obligation refunding bonds.
--Greene CSD, N.Y., $5.4 million of school district bonds.
--Nassau County, N.Y., $4.4 million and $89 million of improvement bonds.
--Springfield Township SD, Pa., $9.9 million GO bonds.
--Pickens County, SD, S.C., $3.2 million, $3 million, $1.2 million, $12 million and $7 million of GO bonds.
